g.text: UPS RESERVE: actual charging, cell protection, power path, NTC and current limits must be designed after chip selection.

g.desc: UPS RESERVE: actual charging, cell protection, power path, NTC and current limits must be designed after chip selection.

g.text: JP1 one shunt: 1-2 BOARD_REG_5V / SYS_5V OR 2-3 SYS_5V / BENCH_REG_5V. Both sources regulated 5V.

g.desc: JP1 one shunt: 1-2 BOARD_REG_5V / SYS_5V OR 2-3 SYS_5V / BENCH_REG_5V. Both sources regulated 5V.

g.text: INPUT: nominal 5V/2A, 4.5-5.5V range. F1/Q6 protection; JP4 selects direct or future UPS; parallel 3.8V/5V rails.

g.desc: INPUT: nominal 5V/2A, 4.5-5.5V range. F1/Q6 protection; JP4 selects direct or future UPS; parallel 3.8V/5V rails.

g.text: J19 VBAT: one shunt only 1-2 internal buck OR 2-3 external regulated 3.8V at J20; none isolates modem. Never 5V at J20.

g.desc: J19 VBAT: one shunt only 1-2 internal buck OR 2-3 external regulated 3.8V at J20; none isolates modem. Never 5V at J20.

g.text: USB: SERVICE R26/R27/R30 OR HOST R28/R29/R31 + J22, never both. J22 = GND/DP20/DM19. J13 pins28/29 NC. Hardware USB test pending.

g.desc: USB: SERVICE R26/R27/R30 OR HOST R28/R29/R31 + J22, never both. J22 = GND/DP20/DM19. J13 pins28/29 NC. Hardware USB test pending.

g.text: No firmware changes: optional radar RX GPIO6 / reserved TX GPIO8; button GPIO0; modem PWRKEY GPIO11 / RESET GPIO21 proposed only.

g.desc: No firmware changes: optional radar RX GPIO6 / reserved TX GPIO8; button GPIO0; modem PWRKEY GPIO11 / RESET GPIO21 proposed only.

g.text: Battery ADC: GPIO2 ADC1_CH1, enable GPIO9; 150k/100k + 100nF; Vbat = 2.5 x calibrated ADC volts. Protected 1S 4.2V assumed.

g.desc: Battery ADC: GPIO2 ADC1_CH1, enable GPIO9; 150k/100k + 100nF; Vbat = 2.5 x calibrated ADC volts. Protected 1S 4.2V assumed.
